description: This header file defines the MiscService class, a subclass of ModemService, responsible for handling miscellaneous modem-related commands such as retrieving IMEI and updating time. It includes method declarations for handling commands, setting timezone, and internal helpers for timezone parsing.

classes.name: MiscService
classes.description: A class providing miscellaneous modem services such as IMEI retrieval and timezone management.

methods.name: HandleGetIMEI
methods.description: Handles the command to retrieve the IMEI number.

methods.name: HandleTimeUpdate
methods.description: Handles the command to update time.

methods.name: SetTimeZone
methods.description: Sets the timezone for the service.

methods.name: ParseTimeZone
methods.description: Parses the timezone string to determine offset.

methods.name: TimeZoneOffset
methods.description: Calculates timezone offset in seconds based on given UTC time.
